package.description: An honest gauge for your coding agents.

en-US.description: An honest gauge for your coding agents.
en-US.longDescription:
telltale is a dispatch room where several coding-agent CLIs answer one brief
side by side, standing on a statusline and a cross-vendor HUD where every
number is traceable to measured tool output. A value it cannot source is
shown as absent rather than as a plausible zero, and a value it derived is
marked as derived.

One binary. `telltale council` is the dispatch room, and it is the product.
The two gauges under it are `telltale statusline` (an in-prompt statusline
for Claude Code and Antigravity CLI) and `telltale hud` (a watch-mode TUI
across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, Cursor and Grok
CLI). The same binary carries `telltale snapshot` (the fleet state as one
JSON document for a program to read), `telltale doctor` (a launch-time
preflight over the vendor binaries), and the relays that collect token
counts and fleet events.

Windows is the continuously verified target: every commit runs the suite,
the build and binary-level smokes on windows-latest.
en-US.name: telltale
